summary: The two main theorems are genuinely new — nothing in pinned Mathlib or TauCeti states them — but the proof re-derives four things that located lemmas already provide: `presentedForm_one_neg_one`, the binary-to-hyperbolic argument of `equivalent_weightedSumSquares_self_neg_hyperbolicPlane`, `ZModModule.add_self`/`neg_eq_self` for the square-class group, and `IsRepresentedBy.not_anisotropic`.
